main.description: A puzzle published by a host, with one or more clues to solve.

clue.description: id is opaque, assigned once at authoring time, and never changes -- attempts and comments reference it by id, so it must outlive any later edit to name, prompt, or answerBlock. name is the human-facing label (defaults to 1..n; may itself encode presentational meaning, e.g. grid position for a crossword) and can be freely re-edited by the author without affecting existing references.

answerBlock.description: Encrypted. Decrypts to { canonical: string, accepted: [{ match: string } | { match: string, hint: string }] }. Opaque to the lexicon by design, so its internal shape can change freely without a protocol-level compatibility concern.
